content.short: Sahara AI is a decentralized AI blockchain network designed for the equitable ownership and sharing of AI assets.
content.description: Sahara AI is a pioneering decentralized Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered to power the emerging agentic economy. The platform provides a secure and transparent framework for users to create, share, and monetize AI assets—including advanced models, high-quality datasets, and autonomous agents—while maintaining total ownership and provenance. By providing the infrastructure for verifiable and privacy-preserving AI, Sahara ensures that every contribution is fairly rewarded and that development remains open and inclusive for all participants.
